title: Micro5 Font
description: A smooth, compact pixel font with rounded curves that's gentle on the eyes while maximizing screen space.
body:
# Micro5 Font for Minecraft

Transform your Minecraft with **Micro5** - a smooth, refined pixel font that balances compact design with soft, readable curves!

![Micro5 Font Showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/XlpbtO6E/images/fc7d6717681f1ec0fbd7577e0b93e98b164aa199.png)

## ✨ Features

**Micro5** brings a unique blend of compactness and elegance, perfect for players who want:
- Smooth, rounded pixel letterforms
- Space-efficient design without harshness
- Gentle curves that are easy on the eyes
- A sophisticated take on retro typography

## 📦 What's Included

This resource pack replaces Minecraft's default font with Micro5 across the entire game - menus, chat, signs, books, and all UI elements.

## 🎮 Installation

1. Download the resource pack
2. Place the `.zip` file in your `resourcepacks` folder
3. Open Minecraft and go to **Options → Resource Packs**
4. Move **Micro5 Font** to the active side
5. Enjoy your new font!

## 💡 Perfect For

- Players who prefer softer, rounded aesthetics
- Anyone wanting a compact yet friendly font
- Builders seeking elegant sign typography
- Those who find harsh pixels too sharp

## 📋 Credits

This pack uses **Micro5** font by The Soft Type Project Authors, licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.

## 🔧 Compatibility

- **Supports:** Minecraft 1.13+
- **Works with:** All Minecraft versions that support custom fonts
- **Compatible with:** Other resource packs (as long as they don't modify fonts)

---

Upgrade your Minecraft text today with Micro5! ✨
